# vyrn-epoch roster vectors (spec/08-epochs.md §9.6).
# roster_hash = derive_key("vyrn      v1 roster", genesis_hash || mode || roster).
# Fixture: testkit::roster. LDN voter i has vote seed [0x41+i; 32] and GXK seed [2, i, 0xC7 x 30];
# LDN vyrn-seq box j has seq seed [0x90+j; 32] and XK seed [0x98+j; 32].
# Data box i of home h has X25519 seed [0x30+8h+i; 32]. fetch_key = K_fetch(8, i, 0) of
# LDN data box 0, for each requester i (voters, then vyrn-seq boxes).
# EpoConfig(8) is LDN with seq_order BASE [n, n+1], CHAIN [n, n+3].
# verdict is Membership::from_roster; CHAIN passes a signer table whose rotation 0 is the
# roster's bridge set. A reject_ case edits the fixture as its name says;
# its roster_hash is the hash of the edited bytes unless the case edits the hash itself.
